notes:
Fixed login on EOS-era builds (Chapter 4+, e.g. 24.20 and 27.11): the EOS SDK's own TLS stack bypassed the in-game redirect, so EOS_Auth_Login went to Epic and died with EOS_NoConnection. The backend now serves the SDK service map pointed at http://127.0.0.1:3551, so native EOS auth lands on the local backend — verified in-game to lobby + shop on 21.51, 24.20 and 27.11.

Also in this release:
- Clean update: every update now purges files that belonged to older releases but are absent from the new payload (payload manifest + post-install purge) — the install dir ends identical to a fresh install.
- Backend data root keeps shipped seeds in sync via a hashed seed manifest: stale shipped files (including old "Idols" branding) are refreshed or removed at startup; user-modified and user-created data is preserved.
- Installer fix: eos-sdk-config.json was being pruned from the package — EOS login could only work on dev machines.
- New backend routes for EOS-era clients: /epic/oauth/v1/token, exchange_code grant, EOS presence PUT, product-users search, internal party v2.
- Diagnostics gains a "Shipped backend files" check plus a one-click reset that re-seeds shipped files without a reinstall.
